_comment: Copy to sap_config.json and fill in. sap_config.json is gitignored — never commit real credentials.
_verify_ssl: Most B1 Service Layers ship a self-signed certificate. Set false ONLY on a trusted internal network; over the internet this disables the check that you are talking to your own server.
_aging_basis: 'due' ages from DocDueDate — how overdue the debt is, which is what credit control asks. 'posting' ages from DocDate instead.
_not_due_bucket: Where an invoice that is not yet due goes. '0_30' reads that bucket as 'current and up to a month past due'. 'exclude' leaves future invoices out of the buckets — the balance still includes them, so expect a bigger mismatch.
_erpnext: Only needed for --push. Generate the key and secret on the ERPNext user (Settings > API Access). Leave blank to produce a file and load it yourself.
